description: Fix database persistence on Railway: Daily and balance xu updates fail because Railway's ephemeral filesystem loses SQLite data on redeploy. Make database path configurable via DATABASE_PATH env var to support persistent volume mount on Railway.
steps: 1. Read src/database/init.ts (line 17) - change hardcoded path.join(process.cwd(), 'data') to use process.env.DATABASE_PATH || path.join(process.cwd(), 'data'). Update console log to show actual path used.

2. Read src/modules/daily-module/entry_point.ts (line 48-50) - change hardcoded data directory check and database path to use process.env.DATABASE_PATH || path.join(process.cwd(), 'data'). Ensure dataDir variable references the env var first.
3. Read src/modules/balance-module/entry_point.ts (line 37) - change hardcoded database path to use process.env.DATABASE_PATH with fallback, matching pattern from init.ts.
4. Search for other modules using 'economy.db' path - update any other hardcoded references to use DATABASE_PATH env var. Common modules to check: shop-module, quest-module, vip-module.
5. Add DATABASE_PATH documentation to README.md under 'Cấu Hình (.env)' section, explaining Railway users should set it to /app/data or mounted volume path.
6. Test locally: Set DATABASE_PATH=/tmp/testdb in .env, run npm run build && npm start, run /daily command, verify xu increases in database at /tmp/testdb/economy.db using sqlite3 CLI or DB browser.
acceptance_criteria: DATABASE_PATH env var controls where economy.db is stored across all modules
When DATABASE_PATH is unset, falls back to ./data/economy.db (current behavior)
When DATABASE_PATH is set to /custom/path, economy.db is created at /custom/path/economy.db
/daily command writes to database and xu balance persists across bot restarts when DATABASE_PATH points to persistent storage
/balance command reads correct xu amount from the database
README.md documents DATABASE_PATH configuration for Railway deployment
verification: Build: npm run build - must complete without errors
Run /daily command in Discord - check console logs show database at /tmp/dbtest/economy.db
Run /balance command - verify xu amount matches what /daily awarded
Stop bot, restart bot with same DATABASE_PATH, run /balance - verify xu persists
Check /tmp/dbtest/economy.db exists and contains daily_users table with correct balance using: sqlite3 /tmp/dbtest/economy.db 'SELECT * FROM daily_users;'
findings:

3. Updated src/modules/balance-module/entry_point.ts - Added DATABASE_PATH support with fallback pattern
4. Updated src/modules/vip-module/entry_point.ts - Added DATABASE_PATH support
5. Updated src/modules/shop-module/entry_point.ts - Added DATABASE_PATH support in inline database access
6. Updated src/web/api/dashboardRoutes.ts - Added DATABASE_PATH support for API routes
7. Added comprehensive DATABASE_PATH documentation to README.md explaining Railway setup and persistent volume configuration

- Run npm run build
- Start bot and test /daily and /balance commands
- Verify database created at custom path
